evidenceClass: new measured target-VM Rust SSE2 result
caveat: Source-shaped synthetic inference-only microbenchmark. It measures the runtime-admitted SSE2 math path but excludes actual fresh/evolved genomes and sensor observations, sensing, physics, frames, Node, N-API, the live coordinator, parallelism, and end-to-end server latency; it cannot by itself satisfy the Stage 4 production-workload gate.

workload.description: 300 differently weighted synthetic population brains, v3/32-bin input shape, five-layer 256-wide MLP, GRU-96, Dense-2

oneStepComparisonProbe.scope: raw complete-population Float32 result from the shared initial state; excluded from timed samples and reset before warmup; compare element by element rather than comparing rounded hashes
